selection.basis: A00067 was independently consumed PASS by C00071/Q00003. Immutable Release/atlas geometry is reused; current outrun-first-pass-edit-v2 requires direct decoded-source classification, source-effect masks and CLEAN_PLATE before Korean rendering.

material_advance.description: Converts C-accepted pre-v2 Release/atlas geometry into 66 executable v2 direct-inspection work units with exact atlas cells, strict 2px guards, deterministic RGBA32 size-derived row-scope templates, header confirmation, semantic classification/binding, source-effect-mask and CLEAN_PLATE output contracts.

reused_immutable_evidence.reason: Q00003 accepted immutable upstream source objects, all 66 exact x4 region relations and all 60 canonical semantic pairs; those heavy checks are reused.
